{{Quote|I am the leader of the most powerful droid army the galaxy has ever seen!|General Grievous, to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>}}
'''Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies''', also called '''Separatist Supreme Commander''' or '''Supreme Commander of the Separatist forces''', was the title held by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as the absolute leader of the [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederacy military]], until his [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|demise]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. He allegedly inherited this [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] from [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]].

The title also operated as the head of the military's [[Office of the General]].<ref name="Double Conscription" />
